Job Purpose:
Coordinate and execute the end-to-end Go-To-Market (GTM) delivery and technical integration of digital partnership initiatives. Reporting directly to the Head of GTM & Delivery, this role acts as the operational engine for launching new digital services, ensuring seamless cross-functional execution, robust partner onboarding, and rapid post-launch troubleshooting to accelerate time-to-market and guarantee optimal service performance.

Main Responsibility:

Integration & Delivery Coordination: Manage the day-to-day tactical execution of technical onboarding for new digital partners. Coordinate seamlessly across internal squads (IT, Billing, Network, Customer Care) and external partner engineering teams to ensure API integrations, billing setups, and system configurations are completed on schedule.

GTM Execution & Launch Readiness: Execute the tactical steps of the commercial launch plan. Drive User Acceptance Testing (UAT), validate end-to-end customer payment journeys, and ensure all operational checklists and system readiness criteria are fully met prior to commercial rollout.

Incident Management & Troubleshooting: Act as the operational focal point for live digital services. Rapidly investigate delivery bottlenecks, resolve technical friction, and coordinate with IT and partners to fix user-facing errors, ensuring minimal disruption to the customer experience.

Performance Tracking & Reporting: Track integration milestones, daily delivery metrics, and post-launch operational health. Generate accurate, actionable reports and dashboards for the Head of GTM & Delivery to provide full visibility into project status, technical bottlenecks, and service stability.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the active bridge between the commercial partnership owners (e.g., Gaming, OTT, Payments) and technical execution teams. Ensure that commercial requirements, revenue-share models, and campaign mechanics are accurately translated into flawless technical deliverables.

Key Output:
On-Time Project Delivery: The successful, on-schedule technical integration and commercial launch of digital partnership initiatives, eliminating operational delays.
Frictionless User Journeys: Completed, rigorously tested customer journeys (UAT) that result in zero-defect product launches and a seamless digital experience for the end-user.
Rapid Incident Resolution: Measurable reduction in issue resolution times for live services, maintaining high Transaction Success Rates (TSR) and system uptime through proactive troubleshooting.
Accurate Operational Visibility: The consistent delivery of precise, timely reports providing leadership with clear insights into delivery pipelines, launch readiness, and post-launch performance.

Employment Status:

Permanent (P)

su-excl-1369581266.d:
Job Purpose:

This executive role functions as the strategic and commercial nexus of the ICT & Services organization, exercising a multi-dimensional mandate to drive fiscal discipline, operational scalability, and market penetration. The incumbent serves as the primary architect of the division's value proposition, operating at the intersection of product engineering, financial stewardship, and commercial execution. This role ensures that all ICT solutions and Services are built profitably, launched effectively, and sold at scale. The role of authority: 1.The Productization Architect The incumbent is tasked with leading the "Productization Factory," a mission-critical function that transforms fragmented technologies and bespoke technical labor into a portfolio of standardized, repeatable, and high-margin products. This involves: Architecting Scalable Frameworks, Service Standardization, Portfolio Integration: Harmonizing hardware, software, and managed layers into unified, market-ready solutions. 2.Division Cost Champion (The Financial Steward) Serving as the primary guardian of the division’s fiscal integrity, the incumbent is charged with the rigorous governance of COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) and OPEX (Operating Expenditure). Responsibilities include; Margin Optimization: Conducting granular cost-benefit analyses and EBITDA, Vendor & OEM Negotiation: strategic relationships with principles. Lifecycle Cost Management: Monitoring the total cost of ownership (TCO) to ensure long-term commercial viability. 3.Go-to-Market Strategy (The Commercial Strategist) Strategy of market entry and expansion, the incumbent defines the commercial blueprint for the entire portfolio. This encompasses: Value Architecture, Commercial Modelling, including subscription-based models, Device-as-a-Service (DaaS), and tiered Managed Services pricing. Sales Enablement & Institutionalization: Developing high-impact GTM playbooks and training frameworks to empower the sales force to sell complex digital transformation solutions at scale. The incumbent governs a diverse and sophisticated ecosystem of scalable products, categorized as follows: •Hybrid Infrastructure & Connectivity: High-availability Data Center & Colocation services, alongside next-generation SD-WAN+ and Managed Network CPE frameworks. •Device-as-a-Service (DaaS) & Mobility: Full-spectrum hardware fleets (Computing, Tablets, Smart Devices) and specialized Smart POS and Acoustic Solutions (Soundbox). •Vertical-Specific Solutions: enterprise applications including Document Management System (DMS), Hyper Converge Infrastructure (HCI), Command Center solution, Customer Relation Management (CRM), Enterprise Resource Management (ERP), Backup Solution, HRIS, Accounting, & Clinic Management Systems. •Lifecycle & Professional Services: High-value human capital offerings spanning Strategic Consultation, Training, Migration, and Installation/Dismantle services. •Managed & On-Demand Operations: Oversight of 24/7 Managed Services and flexible on-demand technical support module

Main Responsibility:

1.Service Productization (NSI Governance): Lead the "productization factory" for the division. Establish and govern the New Service Introduction (NSI) process from idea to launch.
2.Service Definition (SOWs, SLAs): Author and govern the master "service definition" documents, standard Statements of Work (SOWs), and commercial SLAs for all services.
3.Go-to-Market (GTM) Architecture: Design, orchestrate, and execute the end-to-end GTM strategy for all ICT services, defining value propositions, target segments, and channel strategies.
4.GTM Launch Management: Act as the "mission control" for all NSI launches, coordinating readiness across Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Finance.
5.Cost Championship & COGS Governance: Act as the division's "Cost Champion." Scrutinize and govern the COGS for all services (hardware, software, vendor support, labor).
6.Cost Modeling & Standardization: Build and own the master cost models for all services, ensuring all sales proposals are built on accurate, standardized, and profitable cost inputs.
7.Vendor Cost-Down Initiatives: Partner with Procurement to lead proactive initiatives to drive down vendor costs for hardware, software, and 3rd-party services.
8.Pricing & Commercial Strategy: Develop and own the master pricing strategy and price book for all ICT services, creating innovative and profitable commercial models.
9.Service Bundling Framework: Create and manage the commercial framework for bundling services, ensuring profitability and ease-of-sale.
10.Lifecycle Management & Performance Analytics: Oversee the in-life P&L performance of the portfolio, tracking revenue and margin by product, and recommending enhancements or EOL.
11.Sales Enablement Collateral: Create the full suite of sales enablement collateral, battle cards, and training programs to empower the sales force.
12.Channel Program Development: Work with the Channel team to develop specific GTM programs and incentives for partners.
13.Competitive Positioning: Act as the SME on the ICT competitive landscape, articulating clear differentiators.
14.Operational Readiness Validation: Act as the commercial "gate" in the NSI process, ensuring Operations has signed off on the deliverability and cost of a new service before launch.

Employment Status:

Contract (C)

1. Persyaratan Pendidikan

• Minimal SMA/SMK sederajat.
• Diutamakan lulusan: SMK Peternakan/sederajat

2. Pengalaman Kerja

• Minimal 1 tahun pengalaman di bidang farm unggas atau pengelolaan OVK.
• Fresh graduate dapat dipertimbangkan untuk kandidat yang memiliki pemahaman dasar kesehatan unggas.

3. Pengetahuan Teknis

Memahami:

• Dasar kesehatan dan penyakit unggas.
• Jenis-jenis vaksin, obat, dan bahan kimia yang digunakan pada breeding farm.
• Program vaksinasi unggas.
• Penyimpanan vaksin (cold chain).
• Prinsip FIFO dan FEFO dalam pengelolaan persediaan.
• Dasar biosecurity farm breeding.
• Dasar pencatatan dan administrasi stok.

4. Keterampilan

• Mampu mengoperasikan komputer (Microsoft Excel dan Word).
• Mampu membuat laporan penggunaan OVK.
• Mampu melakukan stock opname.
• Mampu menghitung kebutuhan OVK berdasarkan populasi ayam.
• Mampu bekerja secara teliti dan terorganisir.

5. Kompetensi Perilaku

• Jujur dan memiliki integritas tinggi.
• Teliti dalam pencatatan dan pengelolaan stok.
• Disiplin terhadap SOP dan biosecurity.
• Bertanggung jawab terhadap aset perusahaan.
• Mampu bekerja sama dalam tim.
• Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik.

6. Persyaratan Fisik

• Sehat jasmani dan rohani.
• Tidak memiliki riwayat penyakit menular.
• Bersedia bekerja di lingkungan peternakan unggas.
• Mampu mengangkat dan memindahkan barang sesuai kebutuhan operasional.

7. Tanggung Jawab Utama

• Mengelola penerimaan, penyimpanan, dan distribusi OVK.
• Memantau stok dan masa berlaku OVK.
• Menyiapkan kebutuhan vaksinasi, medikasi, dan sanitasi farm.
• Melakukan pencatatan penggunaan OVK secara akurat.
• Menjaga kondisi gudang OVK dan vaksin sesuai standar perusahaan.
• Mendukung pelaksanaan program kesehatan ternak dan biosecurity.

Nilai Tambah (Preferred Qualification)

• Pernah bekerja di GP, PS, atau Commercial Farm Breeding.
• Memahami sistem SAP, Accurate, atau aplikasi inventory perusahaan.
• Memiliki pengalaman menangani audit internal maupun eksternal.
• Memahami KPI terkait penggunaan OVK dan pengendalian biaya farm.

Usia: 20–30 tahun
Status: Bersedia ditempatkan di area farm dan mengikuti aturan biosecurity perusahaan.

Job Summary
PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk is seeking a detail-oriented and organized Procurement Administration professional to support our procurement department. In this role, you will be responsible for handling administrative duties, managing purchasing documentation, coordinating with vendors, and ensuring the smooth flow of procurement operations to support our business efficiency and growth.

Job Responsibilities
* Process purchase requisitions and issue purchase orders (PO) accurately and timely in the system.
* Maintain, organize, and update procurement databases, vendor records, and purchasing files.
* Coordinate with suppliers to monitor order status, ensure timely delivery of goods, and resolve any discrepancies in shipping or invoicing.
* Collaborate with internal departments, particularly warehousing and finance, to reconcile goods received with purchase orders and invoices.
* Prepare regular procurement reports, including spend analysis, vendor performance tracking, and inventory levels.
* Ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies, standard operating procedures, and relevant legal regulations.

Job Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in procurement administration, purchasing, or a similar administrative role (experience in the agribusiness or manufacturing industry is a plus).
* Proficiency in using ERP software (such as SAP) and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel.
* Strong organizational skills, keen attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Good communication and negotiation skills, with fluency in Indonesian and a working knowledge of English.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
